args.title: Halvorsen Supply: Warehouse Automation in 2026 — Summary
args.body:
• Newsletter: Halvorsen Supply's latest newsletter features "Warehouse automation in 2026," linking to a blog article and a companion piece accessible via free email registration (registered with daniel.ferreira@northwind.example).
• Article: Warehouses deploying autonomous carts saw pick rates rise 18%, but integration took twice as long as planned.
• Companion piece: The biggest saving from automation was fewer mis-picks.
